newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Celsius says unit in U.S. light project.
newsitem.headline: Celsius says unit in U.S. light project.

text.p: CelsiusTech Electronics, a unit of Swedish technology group Celsius, said on Wednesday it has entered an agreement with U.S.'s Fusion Lighting Inc to launch a new daylight lamp, Solar 1000.
CelsiusTech said in a statement that the lamp creates an atmosphere of daylight in the workplace and is also energy efficient and environmentally friendly.
Under the agreement CelsiusTech will acquire 7.5 percent of shares in Fusion Lighting.
Other partners include 3M Corp and Compaq Computer Corp that have also acquired shares in the company.
Fusion Lighting was set up in 1993 out of Fusion Systems Corp of Maryland that specialises in UV-based processes.
CelsiusTech said the technology behind Solar 1000 was new and based on one of Fusion Lightings patented technologies.
